verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a docs-as-code platform could plausibly ship per-PR preview deployments. The evidence only shows adjacent features: Git-based workflows with pull requests as the review step, branches that hold changes back from the live hub, and Reviews for approval. Nothing documents an automatic, shareable preview deployment or URL for each docs pull request, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, every docs pull request gets a shareable preview deployment before it merges
